relations: The white platform floats on the churning water, its yellow struts partially submerged and tilting with the waves.
The helmeted person in the red vest stays close to the platform's edge, bobbing as the turbulent water swirls around them.
The blue plastic blocks in the foreground remain fixed while the green water rushes past them.
Small splashes form around the platform as the moving water pushes against its submerged legs.
